//: Vera control tasks — installed by the 'Vera: Install control tasks into this workspace' command (or copy this file's contents into your own .vscode/tasks.json by hand). Every task calls build.sh/build.ps1, or the sys.dev.*/sys.env.*/ide.claude_sessions.* HTTP capabilities those scripts themselves call — nothing here is extension-specific, so these keep working even if the extension isn't installed.

inputs.description: Vera host:port (build.sh/build.ps1 resolve this themselves; only the raw HTTP tasks below need it spelled out)
Restart Vera after setting it? (most .env values are only read at process start)
Auto-sync interval in seconds for Claude Code session ingest (0 = disable). Requires a restart to take effect.

tasks.label: Vera: Restart (native, in-place)
tasks.detail: Calls sys.dev.restart over HTTP — requires VERA_DEV_MODE=1 on the server. Kills every in-flight loop/chat/session on the box.

tasks.label: Vera: Stop (native)
tasks.detail: Calls sys.dev.stop over HTTP — clean shutdown, does NOT come back on its own.

tasks.label: Vera: Sync Claude Sessions Now
tasks.detail: Forces an immediate Claude Code transcript ingest pass (doesn't wait for the auto-sync interval).

tasks.label: Vera: Set Environment Variable...
tasks.detail: Generic .env control (sys.env.set) — needs VERA_DEV_MODE=1 on the server.

linux.command: python3 -c "import json,urllib.request; req=urllib.request.Request('https://${input:veraHost}/sys/env/set', data=json.dumps({'key':'${input:veraEnvKey}','value':'${input:veraEnvValue}','confirm':True,'restart':'${input:veraEnvRestart}'=='true'}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, method='POST'); import ssl; print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ssl._create_unverified_context()).read().decode())"

osx.command: python3 -c "import json,urllib.request; req=urllib.request.Request('https://${input:veraHost}/sys/env/set', data=json.dumps({'key':'${input:veraEnvKey}','value':'${input:veraEnvValue}','confirm':True,'restart':'${input:veraEnvRestart}'=='true'}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, method='POST'); import ssl; print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ssl._create_unverified_context()).read().decode())"

tasks.label: Vera: Set Local Claude Auto-Sync Interval...
tasks.detail: Sets VERA_CLAUDE_SESSIONS_INGEST_INTERVAL and restarts so it takes effect (0 disables auto-sync).
